commands.better_than_village.film.help.1: Filming only on a world copy: /btv film on | off | status | stop
commands.better_than_village.film.help.2: Preparation: film supply; film population 24; film max (up to 12 new houses, up to 48 villagers, accelerated preparation).
commands.better_than_village.film.help.3: Scenes: film expedition [X Y Z]; film develop [1..30 days]; film build; film walls; film shortage food|wood; film role <profession> [1..16].
commands.better_than_village.film.help.4: Nearest villager: film change <profession>. Real demand without bypassing the cooldown: film rebalance. Offline scene: film develop prepare → film develop 3 → film develop status.
commands.better_than_village.film.help.5: on does not disable normal AI. max, supply, role, population are staging commands; shortage and develop are irreversible without a world copy. The expedition is a founder villager, not the vanilla wandering trader.
commands.better_than_village.film.on: Filming mode enabled in this dimension until the world is closed. Use a COPY of the save: commands change the world, off does not roll back. Automatic new expeditions are suspended; running ones continue.
commands.better_than_village.film.off: Filming mode disabled, max acceleration stopped. World changes are kept. Normal expeditions are allowed again.
commands.better_than_village.film.need_o: First /btv film on. Only on a world copy: the commands change population, resources and buildings.
commands.better_than_village.film.no_col: No registered village nearby. Go to the bell of a generated village.
commands.better_than_village.film.popula: Allowed population: 2..%s. Villagers are not removed.
Villagers added: %s; census population=%s/%s; loaded=%s. Normal economy assigns professions; existing villagers are kept.
commands.better_than_village.film.supply: No safe spot for a public storage. Personal chests are not used.
Filming resources added to public storages: %s; did not fit: %s. This is a command handout, not villager production.
commands.better_than_village.film.role.i: Special roles are not assigned by this command; count 1..16.
commands.better_than_village.film.role.d: Staged assignment %s: %s. Normal cooldown and demand apply afterwards.
commands.better_than_village.film.change: Move closer: a free adult villager within 12 blocks is needed, not the elder or a settler.
The nearest villager already has profession %s. Go to another one or choose another role.
Staged change: %s → %s; villager %s; position %s. Skin and tools change through normal logic.
commands.better_than_village.film.shorta: Finish or stop max first: it refills the stock.
Removed %s from PUBLIC storages: %s. Personal items untouched. Professions are not swapped: wait for the normal demand re-evaluation and cooldown.
commands.better_than_village.film.rebala: Real demand re-evaluation: no changes (check profession surplus, 120 s cooldown, cargo, trading and active construction).
commands.better_than_village.film.develo: Terrain changes and offline_development with a non-zero day limit are required.
At least two villagers are needed.

Simulated an absence of %s game days without changing the world clock. Public houses ready to be completed=%s. %s. Earned houses are applied quickly on safe loaded plots; if labor=0, check food and builders. The queue is kept until done. This demonstrates the normal formula, not real-time production.
commands.better_than_village.film.prepar: Finish max, the expedition or the attack before preparing the scene.
Staged storage, population and workers prepared; the calculation has NOT run yet. Film the village BEFORE, then film develop 3, then film develop status. %s
commands.better_than_village.film.max.ru: max is already running; /btv film status shows the state.
commands.better_than_village.film.max.co: max needs terrain changes, auto expansion and offline_development. The command does not change the config.
commands.better_than_village.film.max.at: max preparation does not start during an attack.
commands.better_than_village.film.max.bu: Finish the active expedition or offline-development calculation first.
commands.better_than_village.film.max.st: Developed-village preparation started: target %s new public houses and up to 48 villagers. This is accelerated staging, not an instant village replacement. Limit 10 minutes; loaded plots are needed. Stop: film stop.
commands.better_than_village.film.stop.n: Accelerated preparation of this village is not running.
commands.better_than_village.film.stop.d: Acceleration stopped. Built blocks, handed-out resources and new villagers remain; this is not a world rollback.
